scope: Entertainment game model. The physical inputs are Estimates from cited public figures for each service load; they size the guns' kicks relative to each other. Hold gains, patterns, variation and recovery are gameplay tuning, not measured, calibrated or historical recoil.

units.angle: deg (pitch up and yaw right are positive)

model.resolution: A shot travels along the aim at the moment the trigger is accepted; its kick applies after it.
model.kick: pitch = baseKick x row[0] x (1 + pitchScale x a); yaw = baseKick x (row[1] + yawScale x b); a and b are uniform in [-1, 1) from the shot's seed
model.aim: Each kick adds (1 - residual) x kick to the recovering part and the rest to where the aim settles. The aim rises into the kick with the rise time constant while the recovering part decays with the recovery time constant; the host turns its look by the change.
model.pattern: Consecutive shots step through the rows; a shot resetAfter or more after the previous one, or the first shot, uses row 0.
